rationale: Repeated paraphrase failures across candidate resolution, requested-fact/evidence resolution and request-authority classification demonstrate a class-level language-understanding blocker that deterministic phrase heuristics cannot close generically. Issue #392 authorizes one new generic Governed Semantic Interpreter capability. P0 implements only the deterministic containment boundary required by #393 before any probabilistic provider can affect orchestration: typed untrusted proposals, fail-closed validation, clarification routing, bounded executable outcomes, provenance, execution-linked audit records and failure-origin attribution.
supersession_impact: No existing intent, terminology, context, request-authority, planning, evidence, publication, reasoning, decision, explanation, rendering or release-safety capability is replaced or modified. Existing LLM provider/transport infrastructure is intentionally not duplicated and is not invoked by P0.
authority_impact: The new boundary has zero insurance authority. A validated interpretation expresses only proposed request meaning. AMBIGUOUS/UNRESOLVED proposals cannot become executable typed requests; claim approval/rejection/admissibility/payment/non-payment requested outcomes are outside the allowed output domain; all insurance truth and release authority remain downstream in existing governed capabilities.
